items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: When Chano Pozo joined the band... we went to the Savoy Ballroom, with Chano Pozo and all that, and we formed -- I think it was the greatest band Diz ever had.

ctx.x: Latin rhythms, long when nobody was playing it.
Yeah. When Chano Pozo joined the band, that was.
